name: smolagents
description: created an agent using smolagents for real time web and stock searches using duckduckgosearchtool and yfinance library

paragraphs: A powerful AI assistant powered by Gemini and built using the smolagents framework. This app helps you with various tasks, including stock analysis, weather information, and general queries. It provides an interactive and user-friendly interface to interact with an AI agent capable of performing web searches, fetching real-time stock data, and answering general questions.
features: 🔐 Secure API Key Management: Safely input and manage your Gemini API key through the app's sidebar.
💬 Interactive Chat Interface: Engage in real-time conversations with the AI assistant.
📈 Real-Time Stock Information: Fetch up-to-date stock data using YFinance.
🔍 Web Search Capabilities: Perform web searches using DuckDuckGo.
📱 Responsive Design: Works seamlessly on both desktop and mobile devices.
